name: Rangamati
summary: A lake city in the hills: boat rides on Kaptai Lake, hanging bridge, tribal markets, handloom shops and quiet viewpoints.
season_note: Winter is clear. Monsoon brings lake views and some road landslides.
avoid_note: Check the latest local travel advisory before long trips into the hills.

reach.how: AC coach from Dhaka (Sayedabad, Gabtoli) via Chattogram - Hanif, Saintmartin, Eagle
reach.note: Longer in traffic; often 8 to 10 hours.

reach.how: Reach Chattogram by train/flight, then a bus to Rangamati

local.note: The main way to see lake spots. Agree price and number of stops.

attractions.name: Hanging Bridge
attractions.what: A long suspension bridge across the lake, the best-known photo spot.

attractions.name: Shuvolong Waterfall
attractions.what: A waterfall and small beach area reached by boat, plus lake views.
attractions.tip: Boat trip is the main cost. Wear a life jacket.

attractions.name: Peda Ting Ting restaurant and lake viewpoint
attractions.what: A floating restaurant and viewpoint with a tribal-style menu.
attractions.tip: Try bamboo chicken and local snacks.

attractions.name: Tribal Cultural Institute Museum
attractions.what: A small museum showing the life, clothes and crafts of the hill tribes.

attractions.name: Rajban Vihara
attractions.what: A peaceful Buddhist temple complex on the lake.

attractions.name: Tribal handloom and market
attractions.what: Buy tribal scarves, bags and cloths made on traditional looms.

attractions.name: Kaptai Lake boat tour
attractions.what: A full boat ride across the lake with island stops.
attractions.tip: Hire for a half or full day. Check what is included.

food.where: Peda Ting Ting and local eateries

rules: Take life jackets on the boat.
Ask before taking photos of villagers.
